fixture-aggregates: per-group totals
Data: what the intake did before any statistic
  users   control 360   variant_2 370
  repairs and drops   none; the file passed every rule as delivered

Limitations (*): read every result below with these in view
  * the smallest detectable effect on metric_1 is 68.7% of the control level, above a modest 5%
      lift; a 'not detected' result here rules out little
  * aggregate data carries no per-user pre-experiment values, so CUPED cannot run

Group split: does assignment match the plan?
  intended split not on record; testing whether the share of new users per checkpoint is constant
  variant_2 vs control   3 checkpoints   chi-square 0.09   df 2   p 0.957
  result   stable across checkpoints

Sensitivity: smallest lift this sample could detect, 80% power
  control 10.5%   360 vs 370 users   detectable 7.21 pp (68.7% of control)

Primary metric_1: effect, 95% interval, p; interval first
  variant_2 vs control   +1.88 pp   -2.79 to +6.51 pp   p 0.427   not detected

Early versus late: did the effect fade?
  first checkpoint against the last, of 3 usable
  variant_2 vs control   early +2.00 pp   late +1.96 pp   z 0.01   p 0.995   no change detected

Daily monitoring: 3 looks; crossing a boundary = safe to stop
  variant_2 vs control on metric_1, O'Brien-Fleming spending at the sizes reached
  spending design   never crosses in 3 looks; no early stop in either direction
  naive 1.96 rule   never fires
  final look   effect +2.00 pp   adjusted 95% -2.73 to +6.73 pp   boundary 2.00

Decision: no detectable effect; this test could have seen 7.21 pp or more
